name: synai
description: SynAI - Autonomous Next-Gen AI Coding Assistant CLI in your terminal

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/index.js --external "commander" --external "fzf" --external "marked" --external "nanoid" --external "open" --external "pino" --external "posthog-node" --external "react" --external "react-devtools-core" --external "react-reconciler" --external "yaml" --external "zod" --external "@clack/prompts" --external "@chat-adapter/*" --external "@agentclientprotocol/sdk" --external "chat" --external "@gramio/format" --external "@opentui/*" --external "@opentui-ui/*" --external "opentui-spinner" --external "@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk" && bun build ./src/tui/index.tsx --target=bun --outfile=dist/tui.js --external "@opentui/*" --external "@opentui-ui/*" --external "opentui-spinner" --external "react" --external "react-reconciler" --external "fzf" --external "marked" --external "zod" && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.cpSync('../core/src/prompts/templates', 'dist/prompts/templates', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('scripts', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('../../scripts/browser-client.mjs', 'scripts/browser-client.mjs', { force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist/scripts', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('../../scripts/browser-client.mjs', 'dist/scripts/browser-client.mjs', { force: true });"
